Chapter 18

IngressesIngress

Chapter 17 delved into the purpose and creation of the Service primitive. Once there’s a need to expose the application to external consumers, selecting an appropriate Service type becomes crucial. The most practical choice often involves creating a Service of type LoadBalancer. Such a Service offers load balancing capabilities by assigning an external IP address accessible to consumers outside the Kubernetes cluster. However, opting for a LoadBalancer Service for each externally reachable application has drawbacks. In a cloud provider environment, each Service triggers the provisioning of an external load balancer, resulting in increased costs. Additionally, managing a collection of LoadBalancer Service objects can lead to administrative challenges, as a new object must be established for each externally accessible microservice.

第 17 章深入讨论了 Service 原语的用途与创建。一旦需要把应用暴露给外部消费者，选择合适的 Service 类型就变得至关重要。最实用的选择通常是创建 LoadBalancer 类型的 Service：它通过分配一个集群外部消费者可访问的外部 IP 地址来提供负载均衡能力。然而，为每个可从外部访问的应用都使用一个 LoadBalancer Service 也有缺点。在云厂商环境中，每个这样的 Service 都会触发外部负载均衡器的供应，导致成本上升；此外，管理一堆 LoadBalancer Service 对象也会带来行政负担——每个可外部访问的微服务都必须新建一个对象。

To mitigate these issues, the Ingress primitive comes into play, offering a singular, load-balanced entry point to an application stack. An Ingress possesses the ability to route external HTTP(S) requests to one or more Services within the cluster based on an optional, DNS-resolvable host name and URL context path. This chapter will guide you through the creation and access of an Ingress.

为缓解这些问题，Ingress 原语登场了：它为整个应用栈提供一个统一的、带负载均衡的入口。Ingress 能够基于可选的、可被 DNS 解析的主机名和 URL 上下文路径，把外部 HTTP(S) 请求路由到集群内的一个或多个 Service。本章将带你完成 Ingress 的创建与访问。

Coverage of Curriculum Objectives考试大纲覆盖

This chapter addresses the following curriculum objective: Know how to use Ingress controllers and Ingress resources.

本章覆盖以下考试大纲目标：了解如何使用 Ingress 控制器和 Ingress 资源。

— PDF p.261 —
Accessing an Ingress in minikube在 minikube 中访问 Ingress

Accessing an Ingress in minikube requires special handling. Refer to the Kubernetes tutorial “Set up Ingress on Minikube with the NGINX Ingress Controller” for detailed instructions.

在 minikube 中访问 Ingress 需要特殊处理。详细说明请参考 Kubernetes 教程“Set up Ingress on Minikube with the NGINX Ingress Controller”。

Working with Ingresses使用 Ingress

The Ingress exposes HTTP (and optionally HTTPS) routes to clients outside of the cluster through an externally-reachable URL. The routing rules configured with the Ingress determine how the traffic should be routed. Cloud provider Kubernetes environments will often deploy an external load balancer. The Ingress receives a public IP address from the load balancer. You can configure rules for routing traffic to multiple Services based on specific URL context paths, as shown in Figure 18-1.

Ingress 通过一个可从外部访问的 URL，把 HTTP（也可选 HTTPS）路由暴露给集群外部客户端。Ingress 上配置的路由规则决定流量该如何路由。云厂商的 Kubernetes 环境通常会部署一个外部负载均衡器，Ingress 从该负载均衡器获得一个公网 IP 地址。你可以配置规则，基于具体的 URL 上下文路径把流量路由到多个 Service，如图 18-1 所示。

The scenario depicted in Figure 18-1 instantiates an Ingress as the sole entry point for HTTP(S) calls to the domain name next.example.com. Based on the provided URL context, the Ingress directs the traffic to either of the fictional Services: one designed for a business application and the other for fetching metrics related to the application. Specifically, the URL context path /app is routed to the App Service responsible for managing the business application. Conversely, sending a request to the URL context /metrics results in the call being forwarded to the Metrics Service, which is capable of returning relevant metrics.

图 18-1 描绘的场景把一个 Ingress 实例化为访问域名 next.example.com 的 HTTP(S) 调用的唯一入口。根据所提供的 URL 上下文，Ingress 把流量导向两个虚构 Service 中的一个：一个面向业务应用，另一个用于拉取与该应用相关的指标。具体地，URL 上下文路径 /app 被路由到负责管理业务应用的 App Service；反之，向 URL 上下文 /metrics 发起的请求会被转发到 Metrics Service，后者能够返回相关指标。

Installing an Ingress Controller安装 Ingress 控制器

For Ingress to function, an Ingress controller is essential. This controller assesses the set of rules outlined by an Ingress, dictating the routing of traffic. The choice of Ingress controller often depends on the specific use cases, requirements, and preferences of the Kubernetes cluster administrator. Noteworthy examples of production-grade Ingress controllers include the F5 NGINX Ingress Controller or the AKS Application Gateway Ingress Controller. Additional options can be explored in the Kubernetes documentation.

Ingress 要发挥作用，必须有一个 Ingress 控制器。该控制器评估 Ingress 定义的一组规则，从而决定流量的路由。选择哪种 Ingress 控制器通常取决于 Kubernetes 集群管理员的具体用例、需求和偏好。生产级 Ingress 控制器的代表性例子包括 F5 NGINX Ingress Controller 或 AKS Application Gateway Ingress Controller。更多选项可在 Kubernetes 文档中查阅。

— PDF p.262 —

With the NGINX Ingress Controller we’re using, you should find at least one Pod that runs the Ingress controller after installing it. This output renders the Pod created by the NGINX Ingress controller residing in the namespace ingress-nginx:

以我们使用的 NGINX Ingress Controller 为例，安装后你应该能找到至少一个运行 Ingress 控制器的 Pod。下面的输出展示了位于 namespace ingress-nginx 中、由 NGINX Ingress 控制器创建的 Pod：

$ kubectl get pods -n ingress-nginx
NAME                                        READY   STATUS      RESTARTS   AGE
ingress-nginx-admission-create-qqhrp        0/1     Completed   0          60s
ingress-nginx-admission-patch-56z26         0/1     Completed   1          60s
ingress-nginx-controller-7c6974c4d8-2gg8c   1/1     Running     0          60s

Once the Ingress controller Pod transitions into the Running status, you can assume that the rules defined by Ingress objects will be evaluated.

一旦 Ingress 控制器 Pod 进入 Running 状态，你就可以认为 Ingress 对象所定义的规则会被评估生效。

Deploying Multiple Ingress Controllers部署多个 Ingress 控制器

Certainly, deploying multiple Ingress controllers within a single cluster is a feasible option, especially if a cloud provider has preconfigured an Ingress controller in the Kubernetes cluster. The Ingress API introduces the attribute spec.ingressClassName to facilitate the selection of a specific controller implementation by name. To identify all installed Ingress classes, you can use the following command:

当然，在单个集群内部署多个 Ingress 控制器是可行的，尤其是当云厂商已经在 Kubernetes 集群中预配置了一个 Ingress 控制器时。Ingress API 引入了 spec.ingressClassName 属性，以便按名称选择特定的控制器实现。要识别所有已安装的 Ingress class，可以使用以下命令：

$ kubectl get ingressclasses
NAME    CONTROLLER             PARAMETERS   AGE
nginx   k8s.io/ingress-nginx   <none>       14m

Kubernetes determines the default Ingress class by scanning for the annotation ingressclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class: "true" within all Ingress class objects. In scenarios where Ingress objects do not explicitly specify an Ingress class using the attribute spec.ingressClassName, they automatically default to the Ingress class marked as the default through this annotation. This mechanism provides flexibility in managing Ingress classes and allows for a default behavior when no specific class is specified in individual Ingress objects.

Kubernetes 通过在所有 Ingress class 对象中扫描注解 ingressclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class: "true" 来确定默认 Ingress class。当 Ingress 对象没有使用 spec.ingressClassName 属性显式指定 Ingress class 时，会自动默认为通过该注解标记为默认的 Ingress class。这一机制在管理 Ingress class 时提供了灵活性，并在单个 Ingress 对象未指定具体 class 时给出默认行为。

While Kubernetes doesn’t prevent this configuration, when multiple Ingress classes have the ingressclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class: "true" annotation assigned, it creates ambiguous behavior. Ingress resources without an explicit ingressClassName will typically fail to create, with validation errors about multiple defaults being found, as the system cannot deterministically choose which controller should handle them.

虽然 Kubernetes 不会阻止这种配置，但当多个 Ingress class 都被赋予 ingressclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class: "true" 注解时，会造成行为歧义。未显式指定 ingressClassName 的 Ingress 资源通常会创建失败，并报出发现多个默认值的校验错误，因为系统无法确定性地选择应由哪个控制器来处理它们。

— PDF p.263 —

Configuring Ingress Rules配置 Ingress 规则

When creating an Ingress, you have the flexibility to define one or multiple rules. Each rule encompasses the specification of an optional host, a set of URL context paths, and the backend responsible for routing the incoming traffic. This structure allows for fine-grained control over how external HTTP(S) requests are directed within the Kubernetes cluster, catering to different services based on specified conditions. Table 18-1 describes the three rules.

创建 Ingress 时，你可以灵活地定义一条或多条规则。每条规则包含：一个可选的 host、一组 URL 上下文路径，以及负责转发入站流量的后端。这种结构让你可以对外部 HTTP(S) 请求在 Kubernetes 集群内的指向进行细粒度控制，按指定条件把请求导向不同的服务。表 18-1 描述了这三类规则。

TypeExampleDescription
An optional hostnext.example.comIf provided, the rules apply to that host. If no host is defined, all inbound HTTP(S) traffic is handled (e.g., if made through the IP address of the Ingress).
可选的 hostnext.example.com如果提供，规则只作用于该 host；若未定义 host，则处理所有入站 HTTP(S) 流量（例如通过 Ingress 的 IP 地址发起的流量）。
A list of paths/appIncoming traffic must match the host and path to correctly forward the traffic to a Service.
一组路径/app入站流量必须同时匹配 host 和 path，才能被正确转发到某个 Service。
The backendapp-service:8080A combination of a Service name and port. The Ingress allows access to intra-cluster Services defined as type ClusterIP.
后端app-service:8080Service 名称与端口的组合。Ingress 允许访问集群内以 ClusterIP 类型定义的 Service。

An Ingress controller can optionally define a default backend that is used as a fallback route should none of the configured Ingress rules match. You can learn more about it in the documentation of the Ingress primitive.

Ingress 控制器可以选择性地定义一个默认后端，当所有已配置的 Ingress 规则都不匹配时作为兜底路由。更多细节可参阅 Ingress 原语的文档。

Creating Ingresses创建 Ingress

You can create an Ingress with the imperative create ingress command. The main command-line option you need to provide is --rule, which defines the rules in a comma-separated fashion. The notation for each key-value pair is <host>/<path>=<service>:<port>. Let’s create an Ingress object with two rules:

你可以用命令式的 create ingress 命令创建 Ingress。需要提供的主要命令行选项是 --rule，它以逗号分隔的方式定义规则。每个键值对的写法是 <host>/<path>=<service>:<port>。下面创建一个带两条规则的 Ingress 对象：

$ kubectl create ingress next-app \
  --rule="next.example.com/app=app-service:8080" \
  --rule="next.example.com/metrics=metrics-service:9090"
ingress.networking.k8s.io/next-app created

If you look at the output of the create ingress --help command, more fine-grained rules can be specified.

如果查看 create ingress --help 命令的输出，可以指定更细粒度的规则。

Support for TLS termination对 TLS 终止的支持

Port 80 for HTTP traffic is implied, as we didn’t specify a reference to a TLS Secret object. If you have specified tls=mysecret in the rule definition, then the port 443 would be listed here as well. For more information on enabling HTTPS traffic, see the Kubernetes documentation. The exam does not cover configuring TLS termination for an Ingress.

这里默认使用 80 端口承载 HTTP 流量，因为我们没有引用 TLS Secret 对象。如果在规则定义中指定了 tls=mysecret，那么 443 端口也会列在这里。关于启用 HTTPS 流量的更多信息，请参阅 Kubernetes 文档。考试不考查为 Ingress 配置 TLS 终止。

— PDF p.264 —

Using a YAML manifest to define Ingress is often more intuitive and preferred by many. It provides a clearer and more structured way to express the desired configuration. An Ingress defined as a YAML manifest is shown in Example 18-1.

使用 YAML manifest 定义 Ingress 通常更直观，也为许多人所偏爱。它以更清晰、更结构化的方式表达期望的配置。示例 18-1 展示了一个用 YAML manifest 定义的 Ingress。

Example 18-1. An Ingress defined by a YAML manifest

示例 18-1. 用 YAML manifest 定义的 Ingress

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: next-app
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target: /$1
spec:
  rules:
  - host: next.example.com
    http:
      paths:
      - backend:
          service:
            name: app-service
            port:
              number: 8080
        path: /app
        pathType: Exact
      - backend:
          service:
            name: metrics-service
            port:
              number: 9090
        path: /metrics
        pathType: Exact
  • Assigns an NGINX Ingress-specific annotation for rewriting the URL赋值一个 NGINX Ingress 特有的注解，用于重写 URL
  • Defines the rule that maps the app-service backend to the URL next.example.com/app定义把 app-service 后端映射到 URL next.example.com/app 的规则
  • Defines the rule that maps the metrics-service backend to the URL next.example.com/metrics定义把 metrics-service 后端映射到 URL next.example.com/metrics 的规则

The Ingress YAML manifest contains one major difference from the live object representation created by the imperative command: the assignment of an Ingress controller annotation. Some Ingress controller implementations provide annotations to customize their behavior. You can find the full list of annotations that come with the NGINX Ingress controller in the corresponding documentation.

与命令式命令所创建的实时对象表示相比，这份 Ingress YAML manifest 有一个主要区别：赋值了一个 Ingress 控制器注解。一些 Ingress 控制器实现会提供注解来自定义其行为。NGINX Ingress 控制器所附带的完整注解列表，可在相应文档中找到。

— PDF p.265 —

Defining Path Types定义路径类型

The previous YAML manifest demonstrates one of the options for specifying a path type via the attribute spec.rules[].http.paths[].pathType. The path type defines how an incoming request is evaluated against the declared path. Table 18-2 indicates the evaluation for incoming requests and their paths. See the Kubernetes documentation for a more comprehensive list.

前面的 YAML manifest 演示了通过 spec.rules[].http.paths[].pathType 属性指定路径类型的一种方式。路径类型定义了入站请求相对于所声明路径的求值方式。表 18-2 给出了对入站请求及其路径的求值规则。更完整的列表请参阅 Kubernetes 文档。

Path typeRuleIncoming request
Exact/appMatches /app but does not match /app/test or /app/
Exact（精确匹配）/app匹配 /app，但不匹配 /app/test 或 /app/
Prefix/appMatches /app, /app/, and /application but does not match /admin
Prefix（前缀匹配）/app匹配 /app、/app/ 和 /application，但不匹配 /admin

The key distinction between the Exact and Prefix path types lies in their treatment of trailing slashes. The Prefix path type focuses solely on the provided prefix of a URL context path, allowing it to accommodate requests with URLs that include a trailing slash. In contrast, the Exact path type is more stringent, requiring an exact match of the specified URL context path without considering a trailing slash.

Exact 与 Prefix 路径类型的关键区别在于对尾部斜杠的处理。Prefix 路径类型只关注 URL 上下文路径所给定的前缀，因此能容纳 URL 带尾部斜杠的请求；与之相对，Exact 路径类型更严格，要求与所指定的 URL 上下文路径完全一致，不考虑尾部斜杠。

Listing Ingresses列出 Ingress

Listing Ingresses can be achieved with the get ingress command. You will see some of the information you specified when creating the Ingress (e.g., the hosts):

可以用 get ingress 命令列出 Ingress。你会看到创建 Ingress 时所指定的部分信息（例如 host）：

$ kubectl get ingress
NAME       CLASS   HOSTS              ADDRESS        PORTS   AGE
next-app   nginx   next.example.com   192.168.66.4   80      5m38s

The Ingress automatically selected the default Ingress class nginx configured by the Ingress controller. You can find that information under the CLASS column. The value listed under the ADDRESS columns is the IP address provided by the external load balancer.

该 Ingress 自动选择了由 Ingress 控制器配置的默认 Ingress class nginx，这一信息可在 CLASS 列下找到。ADDRESS 列下列出的值是外部负载均衡器提供的 IP 地址。

Rendering Ingress Details查看 Ingress 详情

The describe ingress command is a valuable tool for obtaining detailed information about an Ingress resource. It presents the rules in a clear table format, which aids in understanding the routing configurations. Additionally, when troubleshooting, it’s essential to pay attention to any additional messages or events.

describe ingress 命令是获取 Ingress 资源详细信息的有用工具。它以清晰的表格形式展示规则，有助于理解路由配置。此外，在排障时务必关注任何额外的消息或事件。

In the provided output, it’s evident that there might be an issue with the Services named app-service and metrics-service that are mapped in the Ingress rules. This discrepancy between the specified services and their existence can lead to routing errors:

在下面给出的输出中可以明显看出，Ingress 规则中映射的、名为 app-service 和 metrics-service 的 Service 可能存在问题。所指定的 Service 与它们是否真实存在之间的这种不一致，会导致路由错误：

— PDF p.266 —
$ kubectl describe ingress next-app
Name:             next-app
Labels:           <none>
Namespace:        default
Address:          192.168.66.4
Ingress Class:    nginx
Default backend:  <default>
Rules:
  Host              Path  Backends
  ----              ----  --------
  next.example.com
                    /app       app-service:8080 (<error: endpoints "app-service" not found>)
                    /metrics   metrics-service:9090 (<error: endpoints "metrics-service" not found>)
Annotations:        <none>
Events:
  Type    Reason  Age                   From                      ...
  ----    ------  ----                  ----                      ...
  Normal  Sync    6m45s (x2 over 7m3s)  nginx-ingress-controller  ...

Furthermore, observing the event log that shows syncing activity by the Ingress controller is crucial. Any warnings or errors in this log can provide insights into potential issues during the synchronization process.

此外，观察事件日志中 Ingress 控制器的同步活动至关重要。该日志中的任何警告或错误都能揭示同步过程中潜在的问题。

To address the problem, ensure that the specified Services in the Ingress rules actually exist and are accessible within the Kubernetes cluster. Additionally, review the event log for any relevant messages that might indicate the cause of the discrepancy.

要解决该问题，请确保 Ingress 规则中指定的 Service 在 Kubernetes 集群中真实存在且可访问。此外，查看事件日志中是否有能指出这种不一致原因的相关消息。

Let’s resolve the issue of not being able to route to the backends configured in the Ingress object. The following commands create the Pods and Services:

下面来解决无法路由到 Ingress 对象所配置后端的问题。以下命令创建 Pod 和 Service：

$ kubectl run app --image=k8s.gcr.io/echoserver:1.10 --port=8080 \
  -l app=app-service
pod/app created
$ kubectl run metrics --image=k8s.gcr.io/echoserver:1.10 --port=8080 \
  -l app=metrics-service
pod/metrics created
$ kubectl create service clusterip app-service --tcp=8080:8080
service/app-service created
$ kubectl create service clusterip metrics-service --tcp=9090:8080
service/metrics-service created

Inspecting the Ingress object doesn’t show any errors for the configured rules. If you’re now able to see a list of resolvable backends along with the corresponding Pod virtual IP addresses and ports, the Ingress object is correctly configured, and the backends are recognized and accessible:

检查 Ingress 对象时，所配置的规则不再显示任何错误。如果你现在能看到一组可解析的后端，以及对应的 Pod 虚拟 IP 地址和端口，说明 Ingress 对象配置正确，后端已被识别且可访问：

$ kubectl describe ingress next-app
Name:             next-app
Labels:           <none>
Namespace:        default
— PDF p.267 —
Address:          192.168.66.4
Ingress Class:    nginx
Default backend:  <default>
Rules:
  Host              Path  Backends
  ----              ----  --------
  next.example.com
                    /app       app-service:8080 (10.244.0.6:8080)
                    /metrics   metrics-service:9090 (10.244.0.7:8080)
Annotations:        <none>
Events:
  Type    Reason  Age                From                      Message
  ----    ------  ----               ----                      -------
  Normal  Sync    13m (x2 over 13m)  nginx-ingress-controller  Scheduled for sync

It’s worth coming back to the Ingress details if you experience any issues with routing traffic through an Ingress endpoint.

如果通过 Ingress 端点路由流量时遇到任何问题，值得回来再次查看 Ingress 详情。

Accessing an Ingress访问 Ingress

To enable the routing of incoming HTTP(S) traffic through the Ingress and subsequently to the configured Service, it’s crucial to set up a DNS entry mapping to the external address. This typically involves configuring either an Address record (A record) or a Canonical Name (CNAME) record. The ExternalDNS project is a valuable tool that can assist in managing these DNS records automatically.

要让入站 HTTP(S) 流量经 Ingress 路由、进而到达所配置的 Service，关键是设置一条指向该外部地址的 DNS 记录。通常需要配置一条 A 记录（Address record）或 CNAME 记录（Canonical Name）。ExternalDNS 项目是一个很有用的工具，可以帮助自动管理这些 DNS 记录。

For local testing on a Kubernetes cluster on your machine, follow these steps:

要在你本机的 Kubernetes 集群上做本地测试，请按以下步骤操作：

  1. Find the IP address of the load balancer used by the Ingress.找到 Ingress 所使用的负载均衡器的 IP 地址。
  2. Add the IP address to hostname mapping to your /etc/hosts file.把“IP 地址到主机名”的映射加入你的 /etc/hosts 文件。

By adding the IP address to your local /etc/hosts file, you will resolve the domain name locally, allowing you to test the behavior of the Ingress without relying on external DNS records:

把该 IP 地址加入本地 /etc/hosts 文件后，你就能在本地解析该域名，从而在不依赖外部 DNS 记录的情况下测试 Ingress 的行为：

$ kubectl get ingress next-app \
  --output=jsonpath="{.status.loadBalancer.ingress[0]['ip']}"
192.168.66.4
$ sudo vim /etc/hosts
...
192.168.66.4   next.example.com

You can now send HTTP requests to the backend. This call matches the Exact path rule and therefore returns a HTTP 200 response code from the application:

现在你可以向后端发送 HTTP 请求了。下面这个调用匹配 Exact 路径规则，因此从应用返回 HTTP 200 响应码：

$ wget next.example.com/app --timeout=5 --tries=1
--2021-11-30 19:34:57--  http://next.example.com/app
Resolving next.example.com (next.example.com)... 192.168.66.4
Connecting to next.example.com (next.example.com)|192.168.66.4|:80...
— PDF p.268 —
connected.
HTTP request sent, awaiting response... 200 OK

This next call uses a URL with a trailing slash. The Ingress path rule doesn’t support this case, and therefore the call doesn’t go through. You will receive an HTTP 404 response code. For the second call to work, you’d have to change the path rule to Prefix:

下一个调用使用了带尾部斜杠的 URL。Ingress 路径规则不支持这种情况，因此该调用无法通过，你会收到 HTTP 404 响应码。要让第二个调用成功，必须把路径规则改为 Prefix：

$ wget next.example.com/app/ --timeout=5 --tries=1
--2021-11-30 15:36:26--  http://next.example.com/app/
Resolving next.example.com (next.example.com)... 192.168.66.4
Connecting to next.example.com (next.example.com)|192.168.66.4|:80... connected.
HTTP request sent, awaiting response... 404 Not Found
2021-11-30 15:36:26 ERROR 404: Not Found.

You can observe the same behavior for the Metrics Service configured with the URL context path metrics. Feel free to try that out as well.

对于配置了 URL 上下文路径 metrics 的 Metrics Service，你可以观察到同样的行为，不妨也亲自试一下。

Summary本章小结

The resource type Ingress defines rules for routing cluster-external HTTP(S) traffic to one or many Services. Each rule defines a URL context path to target a Service. For an Ingress to work, you first need to install an Ingress controller. An Ingress controller periodically evaluates those rules and ensures that they apply to the cluster. To expose the Ingress, a cloud provider usually stands up an external load balancer that lends an external IP address to the Ingress.

Ingress 这种资源类型定义了把集群外部 HTTP(S) 流量路由到一个或多个 Service 的规则。每条规则定义一个 URL 上下文路径以指向某个 Service。Ingress 要工作，首先需要安装一个 Ingress 控制器；它会周期性地评估这些规则，并确保规则在集群中生效。为了把 Ingress 暴露出去，云厂商通常会拉起一个外部负载均衡器，为 Ingress 分配一个外部 IP 地址。

Exam Essentials考试要点

  • Know the difference between a Service and an Ingress. An Ingress is not to be confused with a Service. The Ingress is meant for routing cluster-external HTTP(S) traffic to one or many Services based on an optional hostname and mandatory path. A Service routes traffic to a set of Pods.了解 Service 与 Ingress 的区别。不要把 Ingress 与 Service 混淆：Ingress 用于基于可选的主机名和必填的路径，把集群外部 HTTP(S) 流量路由到一个或多个 Service；而 Service 把流量路由到一组 Pod。
  • Understand the role of an Ingress controller. An Ingress controller needs to be installed before an Ingress can function properly. Without installing an Ingress controller, Ingress rules will have no effect. You can choose from a range of Ingress controller implementations, all documented on the Kubernetes documentation page. Assume that an Ingress controller will be preinstalled for you in the exam environment.理解 Ingress 控制器的作用。Ingress 正常工作前必须先安装 Ingress 控制器；不安装控制器，Ingress 规则不会产生任何效果。你可以从一系列 Ingress 控制器实现中选择，它们都在 Kubernetes 文档页面中有所记录。可以假设考试环境中已为你预装了 Ingress 控制器。
  • Practice the definition of Ingress rules. You can define one or many rules in an Ingress. Every rule consists of an optional host, the URL context path, and the Service DNS name and port. Try defining more than a single rule and how to access the endpoint. You will not have to understand the process for configuring TLS termination for an Ingress—this aspect is covered by the CKS exam.练习定义 Ingress 规则。你可以在一个 Ingress 中定义一条或多条规则；每条规则由可选的 host、URL 上下文路径、以及 Service 的 DNS 名称和端口组成。试着定义多于一条的规则，并了解如何访问其端点。你不需要理解为 Ingress 配置 TLS 终止的过程——这部分由 CKS 考试覆盖。
— PDF p.269 —

Sample Exercises样题练习

Solutions to these exercises are available in Appendix A.

这些练习的解答见附录 A。

  1. Your company has two microservices running in the same Kubernetes cluster: A frontend application that serves the main website, and an API backend service that handles API requests. Both services need to be accessible from outside the cluster through the same domain name (app.example.com) but with different URL paths. Use the F5 NGINX Ingress controller. Create a namespace called webapp. Deploy two applications: a frontend application (use nginx:1.29.1-alpine image, name: frontend, two replicas), and an API application (use the httpd:2.4.65-alpine image, name: api, two replicas). Create ClusterIP Services for both Deployments, a Frontend Service on port 80, an API Service on port 80. Create an Ingress resource that uses the host app.example.com and routes the paths / and /app to the Frontend Service. It also routes /api to the API Service. Use the nginx Ingress class. Verify the proper Ingress configuration by making a call to it.你的公司在同一个 Kubernetes 集群中运行着两个微服务：一个用于主站的前端应用，以及一个处理 API 请求的 API 后端服务。两个服务都需要从集群外部通过同一域名（app.example.com）访问，但 URL 路径不同。使用 F5 NGINX Ingress 控制器。创建名为 webapp 的 namespace。部署两个应用：一个前端应用（使用 nginx:1.29.1-alpine 镜像，名称 frontend，两个副本）和一个 API 应用（使用 httpd:2.4.65-alpine 镜像，名称 api，两个副本）。为两个 Deployment 各创建一个 ClusterIP Service：Frontend Service 端口 80，API Service 端口 80。创建一个 Ingress 资源，使用 host app.example.com，把路径 / 和 /app 路由到 Frontend Service，把 /api 路由到 API Service。使用 nginx Ingress class。通过发起一次调用来验证 Ingress 配置正确。
  2. Your team wants to implement a blue-green deployment strategy using Ingress. You need to create an Ingress configuration that can switch traffic between two versions of an application, with the ability to do canary testing before full switchover. The team decided to use the F5 NGINX Ingress controller. You may reference the controller-specific annotations from the documentation. Create a namespace called production-apps. Deploy two versions of an application: a blue version (current) named app-blue with three replicas with the container image nginxdemos/hello:0.3-plain-text, and a green version (new) named app-green with three replicas with the container image nginxdemos/hello:0.4-plain-text. Create two Ingress resources in the production-apps namespace. A main ingress routing to blue version, and a canary ingress for testing green version (20% traffic). Assign the hostname app.production.com. The traffic routing should look as follows: Default traffic goes to blue version. Twenty percent of traffic goes to green version (canary). Add an entry in /etc/hosts that maps the load balancer IP address to the host app.production.com. Verify access to the Ingresses via this hostname. Test the blue-green traffic routing distribution.你的团队想用 Ingress 实现蓝绿部署策略。你需要创建一份 Ingress 配置，能够在一个应用的两个版本之间切换流量，并能在完全切换之前做金丝雀测试。团队决定使用 F5 NGINX Ingress 控制器；你可以参考文档中控制器特有的注解。创建名为 production-apps 的 namespace。部署一个应用的两个版本：蓝版本（当前）名为 app-blue，三个副本，容器镜像 nginxdemos/hello:0.3-plain-text；绿版本（新）名为 app-green，三个副本，容器镜像 nginxdemos/hello:0.4-plain-text。在 production-apps namespace 中创建两个 Ingress 资源：一个主 Ingress 路由到蓝版本，一个用于测试绿版本的金丝雀 Ingress（20% 流量）。指定主机名 app.production.com。流量路由应如下：默认流量走蓝版本，20% 流量走绿版本（金丝雀）。在 /etc/hosts 中添加一条把负载均衡器 IP 映射到主机 app.production.com 的记录。通过该主机名验证对这些 Ingress 的访问。测试蓝绿流量的路由分布。
— PDF p.270 —
